Container.Name: MTG-Brewmaster
Container.Overview: MTG Brewmaster finds the cheapest Near Mint copy of every card in a decklist across Card Kingdom and TCGplayer, and checks EDHREC for popular, high-synergy cards your Commander deck is missing, and picks the high-impact cards from each new set. Decks can be pasted or pulled from a Moxfield or Archidekt link.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the MTG Brewmaster web interface (8010 so it doesn't clash with DJDownload on 8000)

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings (settings.yaml) and cached price lists, survives container updates

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Path to settings.yaml inside the container
